x: Held over Walton's new one-lap course, which included some tough ploughland. Our boys enjoyed the run, and our thanks are due to Peter Harding for the very welcome cup of tea after the race.

Peter Harding's many friends will learn with profoud regret that he has been stricken with infantile paralysis. Peter has our deepest sympathies and ever sincere wishes for a complete and speedy recovery.
Harry Shields, Alice and Fred Clay, Mr. and Mrs. Len Herbert, Tom Carter, Peter Harding and Walton A.C., Mr. and Mrs.
